respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows an imagery ingestion, processing, and tile-serving pipeline using EC2 Spot, S3, RDS, AWS Fargate, ElastiCache, and Lambda. Satellite data is ingested and processed on EC2 Spot instances, writing outputs to S3 and metadata to RDS. Users interact with the application hosted on AWS Fargate, which queries metadata from RDS, imagery data from S3, and caches tiles in ElastiCache (Redis). A series of Lambda functions also interfaces with S3 and RDS for processing workflows. Bidirectional lines between Fargate and adjacent services (Users, RDS, S3, ElastiCache) are expanded into pairs of directed edges.
